rationale: Started 2026-11-10T08:19:02Z; ended 2026-11-10T08:34:20Z (UTC). I did not produce this decision. Every source_fingerprints file re-hashed to its pinned digest, each checked record's text_path re-hashed to its text_sha256, and each quoted text equals the exact char_start:char_end slice of its held file. I read the original in full (18 FR 4247): EO 10472 of July 20, 1953 establishes the National Agricultural Advisory Commission (Sec. 1, members and staggered terms), its review and advice duties and quarterly meetings (Sec. 2) and a funding bar pending appropriation (Sec. 3); the OCR column order puts Sec. 1 and part of Sec. 2 after Sec. 3, so the CLAUSES:EO:10472#whole span omits them, but the held original contains them. Member terms and the funding bar are not an end of the order. EO 10937 (26 FR 3915, May 3, 1961) only rewrote Sec. 1. The held FR text of EO 11256 (30 FR 14137, Nov. 4, 1965) says in Sec. 7 that Executive Order 10472 of July 20, 1953 and Executive Order 10937 of May 3, 1961 are hereby revoked, with no deferred effect or savings. Cruden found no other ending text, so the whole order ended 1965-11-04 and status no holds.
